findings.title: Jev judging and code composing reach the oracle's decisions (18/18)
findings.body: On gold evidence, Jev answered the soft questions (pricing basis, whose agreement, which products), and code did dates, amounts, bands and composition. All 18 decisions pass, raw and confidence-gated, including S13, S15 and S18, which split the readers. 20 calls, median 184 ms, $0.0004. The one uncertain judgment was S13's genuinely ambiguous pair.

findings.title: Jev is calibrated on our labels, near-perfect on identity with addresses
findings.body: 1,289 labelled questions, all with ECE ≤ 0.10. CRM→ERP identity with addresses: 99.7% accurate, with 95% past the gate at 100%. Names only: 87.4%, with 74% past the gate at 98.9%. It leans to 'different' and made 4 false merges in 408. $0.024.

findings.title: Agents notice a conflicting record, but can still decide on it
findings.body: All 12 readers looked up the CRM row, and all 9 facing a conflict stated it. On S22 (8% submitted, 15% in the CRM) all three still put APPROVE in the decision block, with the 15% case hidden in the approver text. A field-by-field diff in code catches every conflict. Structured inputs should be validated before the decision, with a typed input_conflicts field.
